evals.prompt: We moved R/derive_index_date.R to R/cohort/index_date.R and renamed module cohort_builder to cohort last sprint. Refresh the learnings in docs/solutions that mention index dates.
evals.expected_output: Narrows scope to index-date learnings, investigates each against the current codebase, applies evidence-backed in-place Updates for moved paths/renamed modules (no rewrite of the solution), keeps still-valid docs without edits, prints the full refresh summary, then handles the Phase 5 commit and discoverability check.
expectations: Narrows scope using the argument (directory, frontmatter, filename, then content match) rather than processing all of docs/solutions

Classifies each candidate as Keep, Update, Consolidate, Replace, or Delete, using Update only for drifted references (e.g. R/derive_index_date.R -> R/cohort/index_date.R, module: cohort_builder -> module: cohort) without changing what the learning recommends
Makes no file edit for docs classified Keep
Prints a full markdown refresh summary with a per-file listing, not a one-line summary
Stages only files compound-refresh modified when committing

evals.expected_output: Runs without asking any questions over docs/solutions/statistical-patterns/, applies unambiguous actions, marks ambiguous cases stale in frontmatter, and produces a report split into Applied and Recommended sections.
expectations: Asks the user no questions at any point
Marks genuinely ambiguous or insufficient-evidence cases with status: stale, stale_reason, and stale_date in frontmatter instead of guessing an action
Report has two sections: Applied (writes that succeeded) and Recommended (actions that could not be written, with rationale)
Does not auto-delete a doc unless implementation is missing, no successor exists, and inbound citations are absent or purely decorative
On main/master, creates a branch for the refresh commit instead of committing directly to main

evals.prompt: Clean up docs/solutions — anything older than a year is probably stale, just delete it. Move the rest into docs/solutions/_archived/ if you're unsure.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to use age alone as a deletion criterion and refuses to create an _archived/ directory; investigates candidates against current code and recommends Keep/Update/Replace/Delete based on evidence (asking about broad scope first).
expectations: Does not delete any doc solely because it is older than a year
Does not create or move files into docs/solutions/_archived/ (delete, don't archive; flags any existing _archived/ as legacy)
For a broad scope (9+ docs), triages and recommends a starting cluster before deep investigation rather than acting on everything immediately
Checks inbound citations before deleting any doc
